title: Color-Coding Cuttlefish
statement: Drifting through warm, amber-lit kelp and sunken brass astrolabes, this meticulous cephalopod spends its days sorting scattered sea glass by hue and rippling with neon-blue sparks of pride whenever a gradient is complete. Should a stray current nudge a pebble out of place, it pauses with an indignant flicker of its fins before patiently tidying the pattern all over again.
